title: Mother Richards and her remarriage
summary: Russell recalls the funeral service where the brothers played, and Handy explains his mother took the name Richards from her second marriage to a preacher.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: Was it your mother that was, she isn't living now, is she? No, she passed. Didn't they call her Mother Richards? That's right. Because I went to the service once. Yes, you did. At the church way downtown. Yes, you did. You were playing. I know John and Ted Howard. Yes, I was. Yes, I was. We all, we all, we all. I remember your brother, your brother Julius the one that played guitar.
His name is Julius, right? That's right. He was there also. All of us was playing at the church at that time when she was speaking. And our, uh.
I wondered why her name was, they called her Mother Richards, I remember, wasn't it? That was her, that was her. Was it Richardson or Richards?
Richard. Mother Richards. Well that was her other marriage name.
I didn't know she just took that name as an evangelist. No, no. She was married. With the, for the Richardson.

She was married. She was married and, and, and her husband was a, was a, a preacher, was a spiritual preacher. Yes. And they, she carried his name after then. Yes. And that was the second time my mother had been married in her life. And my father, he had married about, he had married four times in life. Yes. But mother was married one time in life. Yes.
